markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, second-model and neighbor agreement; worklist flag tier 2 for invasive top class.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others ~0% | Strongly favors Invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 94th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↑ invasive · Stromal infiltration score above typical [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules; low score tied to invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Pleomorphism score above typical · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · High score, but failed spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion difference is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), including 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Mitosis and necrosis scores are artifacts; both failed spot checks (0/20, 3/20).
- Pleomorphism is overcalled; cell segmentation failed, so no nuclear measurements confirm it.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 4**: confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 4**: judge nuclear pleomorphism directly; no cell measurements exist.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 4**: count mitoses and look for necrosis yourself.
